summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of the static SMM Panel Admin dashboard (14 pages). All pages load without any JS/console errors and correctly inject the shared sidebar + top navbar via assets/js/admin.js. Interactive flows (modals, filters, tabs, toasts, sortable init, theme toggle, ticket reply) all work. Only one item could not be verified conclusively via automation: jQuery UI sortable drag-and-drop reorder for the Categories table when driven through Playwright synthetic mouse events (sortable IS initialized and drag handles exist).

integration_issues.issue: Could not verify actual row reorder + 'Sorting updated' toast via Playwright synthetic mouse events. jQuery UI sortable IS initialized on tbody.category-sortable (verified via jQuery('.category-sortable').data('ui-sortable')) and 10 drag handles with data-testid='cat-drag-<id>' are present. This is a known Playwright limitation with jQuery UI sortable rather than a definitive app bug — should be validated manually.

detailed_verifications.global: No uncaught console errors on any of the 14 pages. Sidebar + navbar injected on every page. Sidebar sticky, correct active-item highlighting per body[data-page].
detailed_verifications.dashboard: 6 stat cards render (Users/Orders/Pending/Completed/Revenue/Open Tickets). CSS bar chart shows 7 proportional bars (Mon-Sun). Recent Orders (6 rows) and Recent Users (6 rows) tables populated. Quick Action button 'Add User' opens Add User modal (title 'Add User').
detailed_verifications.theme_toggle: data-testid='theme-toggle' toggles light/dark; a 'Theme updated - Switched to dark mode' toast appears; localStorage.admin_theme = 'dark' after toggle (persists).
detailed_verifications.users: 22 rows in #usersTable. data-testid='row-actions-btn' opens a dropdown-menu (verified .dropdown-menu.show). 'Add User' modal opens with required fields (Username *, Email *, Password *) plus WhatsApp/Telegram/User Group/Balance/Status/Timezone. Filling required fields and clicking data-testid='save-user-btn' closes the modal and shows 'User created' toast. data-testid='user-search' filters rows (nomatch string shows empty-state row). data-testid='user-status-filter' has options All Status/Active/Blocked and filters to 18 Active rows.
detailed_verifications.orders: 34 rows populated. Row three-dot 'View' opens Order Details modal (title 'Order #90000 Instagram Followers - Non Drop').
detailed_verifications.services (most important): 41 rows in #servicesTable with 222 feature badges rendered (Non Drop, Refill, Drip, Country, Normal). data-testid='new-service-btn' opens a large modal-xl. Toggling #featRefill reveals 'Refill Settings' section (visible=True after check). Toggling #featCountry reveals a country multi-select control. data-testid='svc-type' set to 'Package' reveals section id 'secPackage'; set to 'Subscription' reveals section id 'featSubscription'. Filling Service Name (#svcName) and clicking data-testid='svc-save-btn' closes the modal and shows 'Service created - TEST Service X saved successfully.' toast. The 'By Category (Sortable)' tab renders each category (Instagram Followers 5 svcs, Instagram Likes 5 svcs, TikTok Followers 5, YouTube Views 5, YouTube Subscribers 4, Facebook Page Likes 4, Twitter/X Followers 4, Telegram Members 3, Spotify Plays 3, Website Traffic 3) with drag handles and 1..N numbering per group.
detailed_verifications.categories: 10 rows in #categoriesTable, 10 drag handles with data-testid='cat-drag-<id>' (1..10). jQuery UI sortable initialized (verified). Clicking category name (via row-action 'view') opens a services modal. data-testid='new-category-btn' opens a create modal. (Reorder-via-drag not conclusively automated.)
detailed_verifications.providers: 5 rows populated. data-testid='add-provider-btn' opens Add Provider modal.
detailed_verifications.payments/tickets/affiliates/child-panels: All pages load with populated tables (Payments 55XXX transactions, Tickets 11 rows, etc.). Tickets: opening a ticket via row action opens a modal titled 'Order not delivered' with a .ticket-thread of 3 messages (user/admin/user) and a #ticketReply textarea + 'Send Reply' button. Sending a reply appends a new .ticket-msg.admin containing the typed text (msgs 3->4, admin msgs 1->2) and shows 'Reply sent - Your response was sent.' toast.
detailed_verifications.reports: Loads with stat cards + charts + top-services/top-users/provider-performance tables (page rendered, no errors).
detailed_verifications.appearance: 6 color swatches present. Editing panel-name input updates the preview navbar text (preview now shows 'MyPanelName').
detailed_verifications.settings: Right-side General panel visible by default. Left vertical .list-group nav has 13 items matching spec: General/Providers/Payments/User Groups/Currency/Notifications/E-Notifications/Tickets/Email Marketing/WhatsApp Marketing/Modules/Integrations/Signup Settings. Clicking 'Payments' makes it .active and shows 'Payment Methods' panel; clicking 'Currency' switches to Currency panel.

critical_code_review_comments: assets/js/admin.js is 1654 lines — consider splitting into modules (layout/renderer, page initializers per data-page, sortable helpers, modal/toast helpers) for maintainability.

Some form inputs inside the Add User modal have no id/name attributes, making label-less programmatic testing harder. Consider adding stable name/id/data-testid attributes to at least required fields (username/email/password).
No obvious aria-labels visibly missing on core icon buttons, but a full a11y sweep is recommended (icon-only three-dot buttons, close buttons, drag handles).
action_items: Manually verify Categories drag-and-drop reorder + 'Sorting updated' toast + auto-renumber of SORT column, as Playwright synthetic mouse events do not reliably drive jQuery UI sortable.
(Optional) Add data-testid/name/id attributes to required inputs in Add User modal for more robust E2E targeting.

success_rate.frontend: ~97% (only sortable drag not conclusively verified via automation)

seed_data_creation: None — 100% static mock data already embedded in the app.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Site is fully static and served from web root. Base URL from frontend/.env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All pages, modals, toasts, filters, and interactive flows work as spec'd. The one remaining unverified item is the actual reorder DOM change on the Categories page via drag-and-drop; sortable is initialized and handles exist, so manual verification is recommended.
